design_overview: A modern, user-friendly flower delivery mobile application designed with clean visual hierarchy, intuitive navigation, and seamless user flows. The design prioritizes product discovery through rich imagery, simplified checkout processes, and real-time order tracking. The interface follows native iOS/Android patterns with bottom navigation for primary actions, card-based layouts for content organization, and clear call-to-action buttons. The color scheme uses soft, nature-inspired tones that evoke freshness and elegance while maintaining excellent readability and accessibility.

key_components.name: Popular Flowers Section Header

key_components.name: Flower Name and Price Card

key_components.interaction: Non-interactive information display

key_components.interaction: Tapping navigates to reviews screen showing all customer reviews

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: White background, padding 16px, 'Description' header in bold, followed by 3-4 lines of descriptive text in gray, 'Read more' link if text is truncated
key_components.interaction: Read more expands full description text inline

key_components.name: Availability Status

key_components.name: Add to Cart Button

key_components.name: Proceed to Checkout Button

key_components.name: Continue Shopping Link

responsive_design: The application uses a mobile-first approach optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. All components use relative sizing and flexible layouts to adapt to different screen sizes. Touch targets are minimum 44x44px for accessibility. The bottom navigation remains fixed and accessible on all screens. Cards and lists use full-width layouts with consistent horizontal padding (16px). Images maintain aspect ratios and use responsive sizing. The design supports both portrait and landscape orientations with appropriate layout adjustments.
accessibility: All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with minimum touch target sizes of 44x44px. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. All images include alt text descriptions. Form inputs have associated labels and error messages. Screen reader support is implemented for all navigation and content. Focus indicators are visible for keyboard navigation. Dynamic text sizing is supported up to 200% without loss of functionality. Color is not the only means of conveying information (icons and text labels accompany color coding).
animations: Subtle animations enhance user experience without causing distraction. Screen transitions use slide animations (300ms duration with ease-in-out timing). Button presses show scale-down effect (0.95 scale, 100ms). Loading states use smooth spinner rotation. Toast notifications slide down from top (250ms). Bottom sheets slide up with spring animation. Card taps show subtle shadow increase. List items use staggered fade-in when loading (50ms delay between items). Pull-to-refresh uses elastic scroll animation. All animations respect system accessibility settings for reduced motion.
icons: Icons follow a consistent outline style with 2px stroke weight. Primary icons used throughout: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification bell), bookmark (shopping bag for cart), heart (favorite/like), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (delete), share (share arrow). Icons are 24x24px by default, scaled to 20px for small contexts and 28px for large contexts. All icons use the primary color for active states and gray (#757575) for inactive states. Icons are always accompanied by labels for clarity except in space-constrained contexts where tooltips are provided.
